checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Water bottle main subject, fully visible

must.why: Body is matte black; only the cap is brushed steel.
White marble with grey veining under the bottle.
Diffused light, soft faint shadow, no harsh glare.

faults.what: Steel cap is metallic, a small deviation from all-matte black; the user didn't ask for it.
Marble covers only the bottom third and the background is plain white, so the scene is a bit flat.

summary: A clean square product shot of a matte black bottle on veined white marble with soft light; the only quibbles are the steel cap and a plain background.
